files.packages/dialect-jest/src/affected/git.t: Runner bug (B27h, suspected): env set on process.env in beforeAll (GIT_CONFIG_* with init.defaultBranch=main) does not reach the git child processes, so `git checkout main` fails.
files.packages/dialect-jest/src/hoist-policy.t: Runner bug (B27h): a dynamic import of the same file with a query string (`hoist-policy.ts?with-a-new-global`) is read as a file name (ENOENT) instead of a fresh evaluation.
files.packages/dialect-jest/src/inline-snapsho: Runner bug (B27h): the helper calls node:test's after() inside a running test (per-test cleanup); the codemod maps it to afterAll, which Provino refuses inside a test.
